description: Permanently delete a blog publication. Only allowed when it has zero articles and no connected domain/external sync/publishing connections — otherwise the API refuses with an explanation of what's still attached (remove/disconnect those first, e.g. delete_blog_article for every article under it). Needs email confirmation: this call does NOT delete yet. It emails the account owner a confirm link and returns status pending_email_confirmation (with a pendingActionId). The delete runs only after the link is clicked. Do not retry; use get_pending_action to check the outcome.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

publicationId.description: Blog publication ID (from list_publications or list_blogs)

name: delete_publication
